scope: Local clean LimeSurvey CE installations with native upload, respondent Chromium, MySQL and PostgreSQL. All survey data were synthetic.
checks: Native administrator ZIP upload, confirmation, activation and update for the plugin; native question-theme ZIP uploads and updates
Author configuration of three initially blank U blocks and preview; active example import, native survey completion, export and codebook
Previous page, removal of a source city, inactive branch removal, two languages, keyboard at mobile width, anonymous save/resume using a new browser session
40 x 40 data supplied via the native form field. Fresh-session UI readback of every number, editing first and last cells, native save and equality of all 1600 exported values
Guest, author and exporter survey ACLs including access to a different survey
Backup, detach and restore, metadata purge, all blocks on one native page
Real global deactivation refused with dependent active formulas and permitted after detaching. Saved response rows byte-equivalent after deactivation, then plugin reactivated.
notes: LimeSurvey 6 source archives are pinned to the upstream release revisions; the revisions leave the runtime build number empty.

Four automated edits include Playwright actionability and scheduling; two animation frames include rendering and host load. Six combinations were exercised concurrently. Timings are observations from this local run.

Each configuration used a fresh isolated database and exercised native global deactivation and reactivation in the same run. One test on 6.15.12 / MySQL initially sampled the UI before asynchronous mounting finished and was repeated in full using a visible-row wait.
